description: Audits any draft against The Sales Operator voice canon (brand/voice.md) and returns specific, line-level violations with rewrites. Checks the banned elements AND the posture: curious not certain, the approach not the receipt, confidence stated honestly, something left unresolved, and learn-first when engaging anyone else's idea. Not a general style critique; every flag gets a specific fix. Trigger on "check this", "does this sound like me", "voice check", "is this on brand", "review this draft", "what's wrong with this", "flag the AI tells in this", "make sure this sounds like me", "does this read as a verdict", or any request to audit a draft against Heath's voice before publishing. Works on posts, articles, newsletter editions, comments, and replies.
